# Verification

Run `yarn verify:changed` before you finish any task, and `yarn verify` before every push. Never claim done with failing checks.

| Command                                 | What it runs                                                                             |
| --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `yarn verify:changed`                   | eslint and prettier on changed files, ls-lint, `tsc --noEmit`, jest on related tests     |
| `yarn verify`                           | typecheck, eslint (`--max-warnings=0`), prettier check, ls-lint, i18n check, `jest --ci` |
| `yarn lint:fix`, `yarn format`          | auto-fix lint and formatting                                                             |
| `yarn spec:check`                       | every AC of `implemented`/`verified` specs has a linked test                             |
| `yarn test:ai-log`, `yarn test:ai-sync` | tests for the `scripts/` helpers (`node --test`)                                         |

- Fix the cause; do not silence it. No `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no `eslint-disable` without a `-- reason`, no `console`.
- No literal `TODO` / `FIXME` comments (`sonarjs/todo-tag` fails). Write hand-off notes as `WS<N> (task x.y): ...` or open an issue.
- Component props are `Readonly<Props>` (`sonarjs/prefer-read-only-props`). Use `type`, not `interface`.
- When you call eslint with an explicit file list, add `--no-warn-ignored` (ignored paths such as `scripts/ai-log` otherwise warn and fail `--max-warnings=0`).
- Paste the trimmed command output into the PR description. Show UI changes on iOS and Android, light and dark, `en` and `ar`.
- If a check fails for a reason outside your change, say so; do not hide it.

```
# ✅
yarn verify:changed && git commit -m "feat(items): add item details screen"

# ❌
git commit --no-verify -m "wip"
```
